value.rationale: The number of distinct prime factors is a structural extremal invariant for odd ample integers; one and two factors are impossible, three is possible. The first occurrence at this minimal support is a natural precise mathematical question previously unquantified even by the general fixed-support existence theorem. The sharp unique 21-digit value and fully bounded certificate are substantive, not an arbitrary finite slice or routine recomputation of an existing table.
